sloka: अदृष्टायाम् च वैदेह्याम् दृष्ट्वा चैव समागतान् ।राघव प्रिय कामाय घातयिष्यति असंशयम् ॥४-५३-२२॥
transliteration: adṛṣṭāyām ca vaidehyām dṛṣṭvā caiva samāgatān ।rāghava priya kāmāya ghātayiṣyati asaṁśayam ॥4-53-22॥

translations.english: 'We started our journey in the month of Ashvayuja with a certain time limit. That has exceeded. What is the future course of action?
